cover_headline: Yash Wore Ravana Costumes Weighing Up to 33 kg in Ramayana, Designer Says
facts: Yash's costumes as Ravana in Ramayana typically weighed 16 to 20 kg, including jewellery, costume designer Saniya Sardhariya told India Today
The heaviest outfits — the Lanka look, Ravana's wedding costume and the costume for Surpanakha's wedding — weighed close to 30 to 33 kg
Ravana's crown still weighed 1.8 kg after repeated 3D mock-ups and reverse-engineering to cut its weight

quote.text: The most difficult part was wearing the crown because any amount of weight on your head feels very restrictive and heavy.
quote.speaker: Saniya Sardhariya

end.headline: Yash Wore Ravana Costumes Weighing Up to 33 kg in Ramayana, Designer Says
end.line: Costume designer Saniya Sardhariya told India Today that most of Yash's Ravana outfits weighed 16 to 20 kg including jewellery, and the crown alone came in at 1.8 kg.
